```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library("thief")
library(forecast)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoltr)
library(covidHubUtils)
```


```{r, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
full_hosp_truth <- load_truth("HealthData", 
                         "inc hosp", 
                         temporal_resolution="daily",
                         data_location = "remote_hub_repo")

inc_hosp_targets <- paste(0:35, "day ahead inc hosp")
getwd()
fc_m3 <- load_forecasts(targets = inc_hosp_targets,
                                        source = "local_hub_repo",
                                        hub_repo_path = "..",
                                        data_processed_subpath = "data/Multiple3_arima_noTrans/",
                                        verbose = FALSE,
                                        as_of=NULL,
                                        hub = c("US"))

forecasts_hosp <- load_latest_forecasts(models = c("Multiple3_arima_noTrans", "Base_arima_noTrans", "Topmost8_arima_noTrans"),
                                        last_forecast_date = "2021-03-08",
                                        forecast_date_window_size = 6, 
                                        #locations = "US",
                                        types = c("point","quantile"),
                                        targets = inc_hosp_targets,
                                        source = "local_hub_repo",
                                        hub_repo_path = "..",
                                        data_processed_subpath = "data/",
                                        verbose = FALSE,
                                        as_of=NULL,
                                        hub = c("US"))
```
